card: Adds unit tests verifying that SelectionResult::Merge correctly tracks the coin selection algorithm when merging manual preset inputs with automatic selections. Without these checks, regressions in how the wallet reports or handles the coin selection algorithm for merged results can go undetected. The author demonstrates that mutation of the merge logic causes the new tests to fail as expected, confirming coverage of the unverified behavior. This is a low-risk test-only PR with no dependencies.
evidence: Author description notes a mutation testing gap: 'With the mutant applied, the merged result is incorrectly reported as MANUAL instead of the algorithm that actually selected the coins... With the mutant applied, both checks fail with manual != bnb.'
problem: Coin selection unit tests do not verify that algorithm attributes remain accurate after merging manual and automatic selection results, leaving the codebase susceptible to undetected regressions in selection reporting.

risk.why: A mistake in this PR would only cause false test failures in wallet unit tests without affecting release binaries or node operation.

scope_notes: Small test addition (+23 lines in a single file).
summary: Adds unit test coverage to verify that SelectionResult::Merge preserves the expected algorithm metadata when combining manual preset inputs with automatic coin selection results. Specifically, it tests that merging preset inputs into an automatic result keeps the automatic algorithm, and that merging a manual result into another result adopts that other result's algorithm.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, though the title and description clearly describe the added unit test.
